scope: Two-minute best-effort background/resume observation of Android Chrome as a listener in a paired synthetic-media session.

source.post_run_registry_change: Only the scenario scope wording changed after the run; the Android Chrome pair, timing helper, timing test, and focused-path registration were already present.

environment.receiver: Android 15 / API 35 AOSP emulator, Chrome 124.0.6367.219, listener-only
environment.sender: Playwright Chromium publishing synthetic microphone audio

scenario.background_action: Android Home while Chrome ran without a DevTools connection; resume the same Chrome tab

media_counters.observation: Receiver RTP counters advanced by 6086 packets during the hidden interval and by 1507 more over the post-resume sample window. Exactly one peer connection remained connected. These are transport counters, not proof of audible playback.

visual_review.observation: At source resolution, the resumed Chrome view shows connected voice status, two participant cards, the background limitation notice, and voice controls. No reconnect banner appears; the explicit playback resume button is not needed in this run. No audible-output claim is made.

limitations: This is Android emulator evidence, not physical-device acceptance.
RTP counters and browser connection state do not establish that a person heard audio or validate speaker/Bluetooth routing.
This does not verify iOS, Safari/PWA, physical lock-screen audio, Wi-Fi/LTE handoff, or release artifacts.
Mobile Web remains best-effort; this result does not promise continuous execution across browser or operating-system suspension.
